arStrings.szText: The Initiate
Return to the First Vault in Skartara and find the Sigil of Tal Rasha
By stepping into the Vault with demon blood in my veins, I have sprung a trap left by the old Horadrim. The way is blocked until we find all four Sigils: keys to a runic lock. Tal Rasha is the last.
Demons poured from the portal like roaches. What was Tal Rasha doing that could have caused this? I must be on guard.
